svg.title: Gate-on-a-hinge analogy next to the real perceptron update
svg.desc: Left: a gate on a hinge with a handle. A sheep is locked out, so the handle is pushed toward it and the gate swings. Right: the same geometry as a perceptron, where w is pushed toward x and the wall turns.
svg.text: a sheep is locked out of the pasture
gate swings, sheep is now inside
y = 1 but ŷ = 0, so w ← w + ηx
sheep = data point x · gate = wall · handle = w · push = +ηx
Locked-out sheep: push the handle toward it. A sheep that shouldn't be in: push away (−ηx).
